leadText: Ray Chase is an American actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with SBV Talent Agency.
plainText:
Ray Chase is an American actor for the English-language dub of . He is currently affiliated with SBV Talent Agency.

==Biography==
Chase was born on May 20, 1987. As an adult, he became a voice actor and was involved with a number of Western cartoons. Chase joined during , where he voiced recurring character Professor Cerise.
